title: i3 Keybinds and FAQ
content:
Part of CachyOS Wiki Notes. From the official CachyOS wiki (last updated 2025-11-02).
i3 Keybinds and FAQ
Credits to vnepogodin (github.com/vnepogodin) for the simple config. X11 only — not compatible with Wayland.
Mod key is the Windows key (SUPER), changeable in the config file.
Notable keybinds













































ActionBindTerminalSuper+ReturnRofi program launcherControl+SpaceKill focused windowSuper+QWorkspacesSuper+1 … Super+9Resize modeSuper+R (exit with Return / Escape / Super+R)Lock screenSuper+LReload i3 configSuper+Shift+CRestart i3 in placeSuper+Shift+RExit i3 (end X session)Super+Shift+E
Documented categories: Application Control, Workspace Navigation, Window Navigation, Window Management, Layout Control, Resize Mode, System Controls.
FAQ
Autostart a program (e.g. set a wallpaper at start) — i3’s flexible autostart feature. At the end of the config file there are lines starting with exec and exec_always:
exec chromium

That starts Chromium in workspace 1 whenever you log into your i3 session.
exec vs exec_always — exec_always runs the action even after i3 gets reloaded. Reference: i3wm.org/docs/userguide.html#exec.
Do multimedia keys work? Yes. General reference: i3wm.org/docs/userguide.html.
Related: Switching Desktop Environments, CachyOS Desktop Environments.
